article.title: Agent’s duty to communicate with principal.
article.content:
214Agent’s duty to communicate with principal.

Section 214  ·  Chapter X  ·  Agent’s duty to principal  ·  page 47 of the Act
It is the duty of an agent, in cases of difficulty, to use all reasonable diligence in communicating with his principal, and in seeking to obtain his instructions.
